zh.title: Textron與Merlin推出無人駕駛SkyCourier UX軍用補給概念
zh.summary: 於9月14日發布無人SkyCourier UX概念；載重6000磅、可運三LD3
body: Textron Aviation 與 Merlin 於 9 月 14 日在馬里蘭州國家港舉行的 Air & Space Forces Association 大會上發布無人駕駛 SkyCourier UX 概念，旨在於常規補給路線受阻時提供軍用物資運送。
設計目標為載重約 6,000 磅、可容納三個 LD3 貨櫃，並能在未鋪設跑道起降；Merlin 指出其自主飛行系統已在 Cessna Caravan 等機型完成數百架次飛行。
若採用現有 FAA 認證的 SkyCourier 生產線，無人版本可利用 Textron 現有製造與全球維護網絡，加速部署。

en.title: Textron and Merlin unveil pilotless SkyCourier UX concept for military resupply
en.summary: Textron and Merlin unveil pilotless SkyCourier UX; 6,000‑lb payload, three LD3 containers; autonomous takeoff and landing
body: Textron Aviation and Merlin unveiled the pilotless SkyCourier UX concept on September 14 at the Air & Space Forces Association conference in National Harbor, Maryland, aiming to deliver military supplies when normal routes are unavailable.

The design targets a 6,000‑pound payload, space for three LD3 containers, and operation from unimproved runways; Merlin noted its autonomous system has already flown hundreds of sorties on Cessna Caravans and Beechcraft King Airs.
Because the SkyCourier is already FAA‑certified, the autonomous version could leverage Textron’s existing production facilities and global support network for faster fielding.

sources.name: AeroTime — Textron and Merlin unveil pilotless SkyCourier concept for…

facts.claim: Textron Aviation and Merlin unveiled a pilotless Cessna SkyCourier concept for military resupply.
facts.sourceQuote: Textron Aviation and autonomous flight developer Merlin have unveiled a pilotless Cessna SkyCourier concept designed to deliver military supplies when conventional supply routes become too dangerous or unavailable.

facts.claim: The concept, named SkyCourier UX, was introduced on September 14, 2026 at the Air & Space Forces Association conference in National Harbor, Maryland.
facts.sourceQuote: The companies introduced the SkyCourier UX on September 14, 2026, at the Air & Space Forces Association’s Air, Space & Cyber Conference in National Harbor, Maryland.

facts.claim: Design objectives include a ~6,000‑pound payload, capacity for up to three LD3 containers, and operation from unimproved runways.
facts.sourceQuote: Current design objectives call for a payload of approximately 6,000 pounds, room for up to three LD3 cargo containers and the ability to operate from unimproved runways.

facts.claim: Merlin's autonomous flight system has completed hundreds of flights on Cessna Caravans, Beechcraft King Airs and other aircraft.
facts.sourceQuote: Merlin said its autonomous flight system has already completed hundreds of flights on Cessna Caravans, Beechcraft King Airs and other aircraft.
